verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents a real REST file API for OneDrive: driveItems are addressable by ID or path (drive/items/{item-id}, /drive/root:/path), uploads work via single-call PUT content (up to 250 MB) or resumable upload sessions, and items can be enumerated through search and delta queries. This clearly delivers the programmatic, non-desktop file workflow at the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documented endpoints for download, move, delete and list-children (move appears only as a user-facing feature in the overview), and independent hands-on corroboration of API file operations.
